description: Gives a rough estimate of someone's color season from the hex colors of their natural hair, skin (cheek) and eyes (iris), with a runner-up when it's close. Returns the estimated season, its palette and a link to ColorSnapAI's free photo analysis, which measures the face directly and is more accurate.

hair_hex.description: Natural hair color as hex, e.g. "#4a3426"

skin_hex.description: Skin color from the cheek in daylight, e.g. "#d9b49a"

name: estimate_color_season
title: Estimate a color season from hair, skin and eye colors
